content: Cloudflare Zero Trust Free plan supports up to 50 users permanently free (not a trial): includes Access (ZTNA) which can front any tunneled app with an identity-based login wall before the origin is ever reached. Configured via Zero Trust dashboard as an Access policy on the tunnel hostname; supports one-time-PIN email auth out of the box, or SAML/OIDC/social IdPs (Google, GitHub) for a nicer single-user login. This is a defense-in-depth layer in front of Django's own login — blocks credential stuffing/brute force at Cloudflare's edge before requests reach the Pi at all.
